title: The Price of Conservativeness in Recompute Variance Estimation over Update Rules and Proxies
banked_reason: The unrestricted all-rule frontier collapses to one on an admissible boundary class, refuting the proposed positive square-root excess lower bound.
gap_reasons: The original field-level kernel is genuinely false over the frozen rule class, and no nontrivial same-assumption replacement supports continuing this field-target run.

The boundary class is admissible and nonempty; boundedness plus the exact arc sandwich forces tau=0; the schedule-uniform empty/full proxy is admissible with exact gap epsilon, positive denominator, and inflation exactly one; and Poincare proves the matching universal floor.
Because the frozen domain and entire rule class expressly include this proxy and multiscale update law, the claimed 1+Theta(sqrt(M/n)) frontier is false.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the exact M=0 block calibration, a schedule-uniform 1+O(sqrt(M/n)) upper bound for the padded uniform-block rule, and a universal Poincare inflation floor of one. The requested converse collapsed on the admissible c0=C0=1/4 boundary: the assumptions force tau=0, and an empty/full multiscale update law with a single observable proxy attains the floor exactly. The surviving results are useful receipts, but they do not supply the matched all-rule field-level frontier.
tldr: The proposed all-rule frontier is false on the frozen parameter domain. The padded uniform update block at \(L_\star\asymp\sqrt{Mn}\) satisfies a uniform \(1+O(\sqrt{M/n})\) inflation bound, but when \(c_0=C_0=1/4\) an admissible empty/full multiscale update law and schedule-uniform proxy attain inflation exactly \(1\), matching the universal Poincare floor.
gap: Existing recompute theory proves expected conservativeness for a fixed update rule and displays an oracle-proxy tradeoff, but it does not quantify the unavoidable price of conservativeness after optimizing over update laws and proxies.
fill: The proposed upper theorem analyzes the anchor's padded block rule uniformly, while the open all-rule converse targets the geometric and missing-information obstruction that a single-rule optimization cannot address.
